WITH actors AS (
    SELECT match_id, striker AS player_id FROM main.ball_by_ball
    UNION SELECT match_id, non_striker FROM main.ball_by_ball
    UNION SELECT match_id, bowler FROM main.ball_by_ball
    UNION SELECT match_id, player_out FROM main.wicket_taken
), roles AS (
    SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) AS n,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS pos
    FROM main.player_match GROUP BY player_id, role
)
SELECT 'event categories' AS metric, kind_out AS detail, COUNT(*) AS n FROM main.wicket_taken GROUP BY kind_out
UNION ALL SELECT 'role tie', GROUP_CONCAT(role, ', ' ORDER BY role), player_id FROM roles WHERE pos=1 GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1
UNION ALL SELECT 'missing profile', CAST(pm.player_id AS TEXT), COUNT(*) FROM main.player_match AS pm LEFT JOIN main.player AS p USING(player_id) WHERE p.player_id IS NULL GROUP BY pm.player_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'missing roster', player_name, player_id FROM main.player WHERE player_id NOT IN (SELECT player_id FROM main.player_match)
UNION ALL SELECT 'unrostered player-match', CAST(a.player_id AS TEXT), COUNT(*) FROM actors AS a LEFT JOIN main.player_match AS pm USING(match_id,player_id) WHERE pm.match_id IS NULL GROUP BY a.player_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'scoring rows','all', COUNT(*) FROM main.batsman_scored
UNION ALL SELECT 'joined deliveries','all', COUNT(*) FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING(match_id,innings_no,over_id,ball_id) LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING(match_id,innings_no,over_id,ball_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'joined scores', 'all', COUNT(s.runs_scored) FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING(match_id,innings_no,over_id,ball_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'runs','all',SUM(runs_scored) FROM main.batsman_scored
UNION ALL SELECT 'roster matches','all', COUNT(*) FROM main.player_match
LIMIT -1

WITH missing AS (
    SELECT match_id, striker AS player_id FROM main.ball_by_ball
    UNION SELECT match_id, non_striker FROM main.ball_by_ball
    UNION SELECT match_id, bowler FROM main.ball_by_ball
    UNION SELECT match_id, player_out FROM main.wicket_taken
    EXCEPT SELECT match_id, player_id FROM main.player_match
)
SELECT m.match_id, m.player_id, p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS deliveries,
       SUM(b.striker = m.player_id) AS as_striker,
       SUM(b.bowler = m.player_id) AS as_bowler,
       SUM(b.non_striker = m.player_id) AS as_non_striker,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE w.player_out = m.player_id) AS outs,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.player_match AS pm WHERE pm.match_id=m.match_id) AS roster_rows
FROM missing AS m JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING(match_id)
LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING(match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
LEFT JOIN main.player AS p USING(player_id)
GROUP BY m.match_id, m.player_id
LIMIT -1

arguments.sql:
WITH deliveries AS (
    -- Each delivery counts once. Only runs credited to the striker enter the score.
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker, b.bowler,
           COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) AS runs, w.kind_out
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
),
batting_matches AS (
    SELECT player_id, match_id, SUM(runs) AS match_runs, SUM(balls) AS balls_faced
    FROM (
        SELECT striker AS player_id, match_id, SUM(runs) AS runs, COUNT(*) AS balls
        FROM deliveries
        GROUP BY striker, match_id
        UNION ALL
        -- A non-striker can bat and finish a match without facing a delivery.
        SELECT DISTINCT non_striker, match_id, 0, 0
        FROM main.ball_by_ball
    ) AS batters
    GROUP BY player_id, match_id
),
batting AS (
    SELECT player_id, SUM(match_runs) AS runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS balls,
           MAX(match_runs) AS highest_match_score,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE match_runs >= 30) AS matches_30_plus,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE match_runs >= 50) AS matches_50_plus,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE match_runs >= 100) AS matches_100_plus
    FROM batting_matches
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS outs
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_matches AS (
    SELECT bowler AS player_id, match_id, SUM(runs) AS runs_given,
           COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE kind_out IN (
               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
           )) AS wickets
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY bowler, match_id
),
bowling AS (
    SELECT player_id, wickets, runs_given,
           SUM(wickets) OVER career AS total_wickets,
           6.0 * SUM(runs_given) OVER career / SUM(balls_bowled) OVER career AS economy_rate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               career ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_given ASC, match_id
           ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_matches
    WINDOW career AS (PARTITION BY player_id)
),
appearances AS (
    -- A roster entry or recorded participation establishes one player-match.
    SELECT player_id, match_id FROM main.player_match
    UNION
    SELECT player_id, match_id FROM batting_matches
    UNION
    SELECT player_id, match_id FROM bowling_matches
),
match_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played
    FROM appearances
    GROUP BY player_id
),
players AS (
    SELECT player_id FROM main.player
    UNION
    SELECT player_id FROM match_counts
),
role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, role,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS frequency_rank
    FROM main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
roles AS (
    SELECT player_id, GROUP_CONCAT(role, ', ' ORDER BY role) AS most_frequent_role
    FROM role_counts
    WHERE frequency_rank = 1
    GROUP BY player_id
)
, report AS (
SELECT ids.player_id, p.player_name, r.most_frequent_role, p.batting_hand, p.bowling_skill,
       COALESCE(b.runs, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
       COALESCE(m.matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
       COALESCE(d.outs, 0) AS total_dismissals,
       1.0 * COALESCE(b.runs, 0) / NULLIF(d.outs, 0) AS batting_average,
       b.highest_match_score,
       COALESCE(b.matches_30_plus, 0) AS matches_30_plus,
       COALESCE(b.matches_50_plus, 0) AS matches_50_plus,
       COALESCE(b.matches_100_plus, 0) AS matches_100_plus,
       COALESCE(b.balls, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
       100.0 * b.runs / NULLIF(b.balls, 0) AS strike_rate,
       COALESCE(w.total_wickets, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
       w.economy_rate,
       w.wickets || '-' || w.runs_given AS best_bowling_performance
FROM players AS ids
LEFT JOIN main.player AS p USING (player_id)
LEFT JOIN roles AS r USING (player_id)
LEFT JOIN match_counts AS m USING (player_id)
LEFT JOIN batting AS b USING (player_id)
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d USING (player_id)
LEFT JOIN bowling AS w ON w.player_id = ids.player_id AND w.performance_rank = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS ids, SUM(total_runs_scored) AS runs,
SUM(total_matches_played) AS appearances, SUM(total_dismissals) AS outs, MAX(highest_match_score) AS highest,
SUM(matches_30_plus < matches_50_plus OR matches_50_plus < matches_100_plus) AS milestone_errors,
SUM(total_balls_faced) AS balls, SUM(total_wickets_taken) AS wickets,
COUNT(best_bowling_performance) AS figures, COUNT(economy_rate) AS bowlers, COUNT(strike_rate) AS strikers,
SUM((total_dismissals=0) <> (batting_average IS NULL)) AS average_errors
FROM report LIMIT -1

),

    SELECT player_id, GROUP_CONCAT(role, ', ' ORDER BY role) AS most_frequent_role
    FROM role_counts
    WHERE frequency_rank = 1
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT ids.player_id, p.player_name, r.most_frequent_role, p.batting_hand, p.bowling_skill,
       COALESCE(b.runs, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
       COALESCE(m.matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
       COALESCE(d.outs, 0) AS total_dismissals,
       1.0 * COALESCE(b.runs, 0) / NULLIF(d.outs, 0) AS batting_average,
       b.highest_match_score,
       COALESCE(b.matches_30_plus, 0) AS matches_30_plus,
       COALESCE(b.matches_50_plus, 0) AS matches_50_plus,
       COALESCE(b.matches_100_plus, 0) AS matches_100_plus,
       COALESCE(b.balls, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
       100.0 * b.runs / NULLIF(b.balls, 0) AS strike_rate,
       COALESCE(w.total_wickets, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
       w.economy_rate,
       w.wickets || '-' || w.runs_given AS best_bowling_performance
FROM players AS ids
LEFT JOIN main.player AS p USING (player_id)
LEFT JOIN roles AS r USING (player_id)
LEFT JOIN match_counts AS m USING (player_id)
LEFT JOIN batting AS b USING (player_id)
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d USING (player_id)
LEFT JOIN bowling AS w ON w.player_id = ids.player_id AND w.performance_rank = 1
ORDER BY ids.player_id
LIMIT -1
